== Japanese printed face ==
Full collector photograph visually transcribed and compared with the English printed face. The Japanese does not explicitly restrict the sale to one of your vehicles or droids, as the English does. It calls the total the selling price rather than an offer that must be accepted. Both physical faces identify Luke's speeder as X-34 in the lore. Publication ID 1301_112o follows the approved Japanese catalog; this is not a GEMP implementation claim. Source preservation remains pending.
